FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I book Jaguar service online?

Yes. Choose your preferred location and date and submit your vehicle details through the booking page.

Do you provide Jaguar spare-parts enquiries?

Yes. You can submit vehicle details, VIN and the required part through the spare-parts page.

Which locations are available for Jaguar service?

Service can be requested at Fifth Settlement, Third Settlement and Sheikh Zayed, subject to availability and team confirmation.
